        <div class="prose max-w-full">
         <p>You'll own Clara's growth engine, supporting our mission by helping more patients discover Clara and turn to it for their day-to-day primary care needs. Landing pages, onboarding funnel, experimentation, attribution, and lifecycle messaging all belong to you. You'll work across the entire funnel - from the first ad impression or search result, through signup and onboarding, into first chat, subscription and long-term retention. You'll partner closely with our clinical and compliance teams to make sure every page, claim and experiment is medically accurate and HIPAA-safe.</p>
         <h3><strong>Your responsibilities</strong></h3>
         <p><strong>Acquisition and conversion surfaces:</strong></p>
         <ul>
          <li>Ship programmatic and SEO-driven page systems for condition, medication and geo intent</li>
          <li>Integrate paid ad platforms with our attribution stack so every channel's true contribution is measurable</li>
          <li>Build and iterate high-velocity landing pages and funnels in React + TypeScript</li>
          <li>Own patient acquisition and onboarding end to end</li>
         </ul>
         <p><strong>Product-led growth:</strong></p>
         <ul>
          <li>Build in-product growth loops — activation nudges, referrals, sharing and re-engagement surfaces</li>
          <li>Design onboarding that gets patients to first real value fast, then to habitual use</li>
          <li>Design, build and launch experiments and MVPs autonomously — from hypothesis to shipped test to readout, without waiting to be told what to try</li>

summary: 这是来自 Y Combinator 支持的 AI 医疗公司 Clara 的职位开招，寻找一名创始级全栈增长工程师。该职位涵盖完整的增长漏斗：构建 SEO 和程序化落地页，整合付费广告平台与归因分析，设计产品内置增长循环，拥有实验平台，并构建生命周期旅程。理想候选人需具备 3 年以上软件工程经验，其中至少 12 个月专注于增长角色，拥有扎实的全栈技术（React、TypeScript、Python）及产品分析经验。Clara 提供创始工程师职位，带来重大影响力、高性能团队，以及为人类健康寿限增加十亿年的使命。该公司已获 1200 万美元预种子轮融资，总部位于旧金山。

mainPoints.point: 该职位全面负责整个增长引擎，而非狭窄的工程角色。
mainPoints.explanation: 职责涵盖从用户获取（SEO、付费广告、落地页）到产品驱动增长、实验、归因及生命周期 CRM 的全流程，要求具备增长思维的全栈工程师。

mainPoints.point: 该职位强调以数据驱动和自主方式进行实验。
mainPoints.explanation: 工程师需独立设计、构建并推送实验，从假设到结果分析全程负责，并负责仪器化与事件分类体系的搭建以确保数据可信度。

mainPoints.point: 该职位处于技术与医疗合规的交汇点。
mainPoints.explanation: 工程师需与临床与合规团队合作，确保所有增长接口在医疗准确性与 HIPAA 安全性方面均达标，突显医疗 AI 的特殊约束。

mainPoints.point: Clara 拥有强大的创始团队与使命支持。
